title: Household Staples Reorder Interval Drift
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=amazon:order
| search reorder_interval_days=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(reorder_interval_days) as avg_reorder_interval_days by _time item_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks staple reorder interval drift over time and breaks it out by item.
value: Drifting reorder intervals often reveal either changing usage or inventory practices that no longer match reality.
implementation: Send staple reorder interval drift events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of staple reorder interval drift by item.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how staple reorder interval drift changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
